chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen's Desperate Lure: The Four Ancestors Awaken on the Steps
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen breaks into the Otherworld with the Three Sovereign Mirror, luring Stone Kings and awakening the four founding ancestors. The fate of the mirror and the Nine Provinces hangs on the Ninety-Nine Stone Steps.
og_title: Luring the Stone Kings: Xiao Chen's Deadly Gamble
og_description: Armed with the Three Sovereign Mirror, Xiao Chen flees into the Otherworld, forcing a confrontation between Stone Kings and the four founding ancestors on the cursed Ninety-Nine Stone Steps.
